description:
Use this when you need to know whether a part will hold a load. Runs the linear-static structural study a script declares with `shape.feaStudy({ material, fixed, loads, meshSize?, minSafetyFactor? })`: meshes the solid with quadratic tetrahedra, solves it with CalculiX, and returns evidence — peak von Mises stress (MPa), peak displacement (mm), the minimum safety factor against the material yield, per-region hot spots named by @kc[...] face ref, mesh-quality trust flags, an equilibrium residual, and stress-heatmap PNG paths.
Requires the external solver toolchain (CalculiX `ccx` plus the gmsh Python module). When it is absent the call fails with `fea.solver.unavailable` and the exact install command — never a silent pass.
Pass { file | code }, optional `study` (defaults to the last declared study), `output_dir` (keeps the .inp/.frd deck for reproduction), `mesh_size` (mm, overrides the study for this run), and `heatmaps: false` for a fast numbers-only run.

code.description: Inline kernelCAD script source (mutually exclusive with file).

file.description: Path to a .kcad.ts script declaring at least one feaStudy. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

mesh_size.description: Target element size in mm, overriding the study for this run.

output_dir.description: Directory for the solver deck, results, summary JSON and heatmap PNGs.

study.description: Name of the study to run; defaults to the last declared one.

name: run_fea

artifacts.description: Absolute paths of the BREP geometry handoff, .inp deck, .frd results and mesh JSON, for hand reproduction.

diagnostics.description: fea.* diagnostics raised by the run.

images.description: Absolute PNG paths of the rendered stress heatmap.

legend.description: Heatmap colour bands { color, fromMPa, toMPa } — the scale the PNGs are drawn on.

ok.description: False when the study violated its declared minSafetyFactor, a selector did not resolve, or the solver toolchain is missing.

out_dir.description: Directory holding the summary JSON, solver deck and heatmap PNGs.

summary.description: Solved evidence: maxVonMisesMPa, maxVonMisesAt, maxDisplacementMm, maxDisplacementAt, minSafetyFactor (+ minSafetyFactorRequired), nodeCount/elementCount/meshSizeMm, quality (minSICN, meanSICN, lowQualityCount), maxStressErrorPercent, trust { meshTrusted, reasons }, hotSpots [{ region, maxVonMisesMPa, nodeId, at, safetyFactor }], appliedForceN / reactionForceN / equilibriumResidual, meshMs / solveMs.

title: Run Structural FEA
